semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Rayama Pack provides plastic molding services and machinery manufacturing, supporting semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Rayama Pack specializes in plastic molding and machinery manufacturing for the semiconductor industry, focusing on enhancing efficiency and reducing costs in manufacturing processes. With a history since 1962, the company is committed to advancing its molding technologies to meet the evolving needs of semiconductor customers.

regional_presence.Japan: Rayama Pack is actively participating in SEMICON JAPAN 2025, indicating a strategic presence in the Japanese semiconductor market.
